# Let it draft a small piece you can read and test {#sec-let-it-draft}

*The assistant as Drafter, kept safe by the smallness of the piece and a test.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
The student specifies a small function, lets the assistant draft it, reads every line, and runs a test before believing it. The first taste of delegation, made safe because the piece is small enough to read in full and because a test stands behind it. Leads directly into the week-nine idea that the test is the contract.
:::
